name: Manhattan Community Award Program (MCAP) (2007-2017)
description: This dataset records allocations made through the Manhattan Community Award Program (MCAP) from fiscal years 2007 through 2017. Each row represents a funded project and includes the fiscal year, the sponsoring city agency, the recipient organization, the project title, and the dollar amount allocated. With roughly 1,956 records across five columns, it provides a year-by-year view of which organizations received awards, what the projects were, and how much funding each received. The data can be used to track funding trends over time, compare allocations across agencies or organizations, identify the types of community projects supported, and analyze how discretionary funds were distributed within Manhattan. It is useful for budget transparency, policy research, journalism, and community advocacy.
